notes: Scoring variant Last-layer. Definitions from MADViT paper Sec. 5.4: Full=all 12 feature losses + final token KL; Multi-layer=all 12 feature losses only; Last-layer=final CLS/DIST token KL only. Full is the repo multi_layer_distillation_loss; Multi-layer/Last-layer share the same forward graph and only change scoring, so this is an adapted reconstruction of the paper ablation. Scoring reconstructed; output is batch-aggregated scalar.
